# AI/ML API

AI/ML API provides a suite of AI models and solutions for various tasks, including text generation, image processing, and more.

Category: Other. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/ai-ml-api/.

## Actions

- **Moderation Completion** (read-only): Classify input text or image for safety using a moderation model.
- **Text Chat Completion** (read-only): Generate text completions or chat responses using a specified llm model.
